entry.title: Τραμπ κατά πάντων: Διακοπή εμπορικών σχέσεων με Ισπανία – Τέλος η συμφωνία με το Ιράν
entry.summary: Donald Trump launched a fierce attack on allies at the NATO summit, announcing a break in trade ties with Spain and declaring the memorandum of understanding with Iran 'over', calling Iranians 'scum', while praising Erdogan.

entry.title: Αρθρο Κωνσταντίνου Φίλη στην «Κ»: Παράσταση για δύο ηγέτες η σύνοδος του ΝΑΤΟ
entry.summary: In a Kathimerini analysis, Konstantinos Filis argues the Ankara NATO summit is becoming a 'show for two leaders', Erdogan and Trump, seeking to revive US-Turkey ties. Erdogan has convinced Trump of Turkey's reliability.

entry.title: Μητσοτάκης στη Σύνοδο ΝΑΤΟ: Πρέπει να λαμβάνονται υπόψη οι ευαισθησίες όλων των κρατών-μελών
entry.summary: From the NATO summit, Mitsotakis stressed that an alliance must rest on good-neighbourly principles, raising Turkey's casus belli in the wake of the Trump-Erdogan talks on the F-35. He voiced support for European strategic autonomy.

entry.title: Το «καλάθι» της Συνόδου: Υποσχέσεις αλλά όχι δεσμεύσεις
entry.summary: A first-day wrap-up of the NATO summit: Trump's remarks on the F-35, lifting sanctions and selling engines for Turkey's KAAN jet left more questions than commitments. Erdogan did not secure an explicit F-35 pledge.

entry.title: Πώς είδε τη συνάντηση Τραμπ – Ερντογάν η Αθήνα
entry.summary: Athens was aware early on of Trump's plans regarding Turkey's possible return to the F-35 programme. Any resolution of the CAATSA sanctions issue would not automatically clear the hurdle to exporting the fifth-generation jets.

entry.title: Στην Αγκυρα ο Μητσοτάκης: Η υποδοχή Ερντογάν στο Λευκό Παλάτι (βίντεο)
entry.summary: Kyriakos Mitsotakis arrived in Ankara for the NATO summit, where Erdogan hosted an official dinner for the leaders. Athens is expected to stress its geopolitical importance and its consistency on the 5%-of-GDP defence-spending pledge.

entry.title: Ουκρανία: Τρίτη ρωσική επίθεση κατά του Κιέβου σε μία εβδομάδα
entry.summary: Russia launched a third ballistic-missile attack on Kyiv in a week, exploiting a shortage of interceptors, while the NATO summit is under way and Trump is due to meet Zelensky.

entry.title: «Αποφασίζει μόνο του το δίδυμο»
entry.summary: Maria Karystianou's 'Hope for Democracy' party appears to be collapsing before it is even formally founded, as members quit citing a lack of collective decision-making and a blurred political identity. Former members describe a tight inner circle around the leader.

entry.title: Ρεκόρ χρηματοδότησης για εταιρείες AI από την αρχή του έτους
entry.summary: Global funding for AI companies hit a record of over 390 billion dollars in the first half, led by the US and Asia. Greek startups have raised more than 300 million dollars.

entry.title: Ιράν: Η νεκρική πομπή του Χαμενεΐ πέρασε τα σύνορα και μπήκε στο Ιράκ [εικόνες]
entry.summary: The funeral procession of Iran's late leader Ali Khamenei, executed by Israel on 28 February, crossed the border into the holy Shiite city of Najaf in Iraq, where thousands of mourners chanted 'Death to America'.

entry.title: Μέτωπο της Ν.Δ. με την ΕΛΑΣ
entry.summary: The government is trying to neutralise Alexis Tsipras's bid to claim the 'moral high ground' through his new ELAS party by constantly recalling SYRIZA's record in office. Corruption remains a weak point for the Mitsotakis government.

entry.title: Ανοδος άνω του 3% στις τιμές του πετρελαίου μετά την ανάφλεξη στη Μέση Ανατολή
entry.summary: Oil prices rose more than 3% after fresh US strikes on Iran, with Brent at 76.54 dollars a barrel. Geopolitical tensions are fuelling market uncertainty.

entry.title: Δανία: Ετοιμη να υπερασπιστεί τη Γροιλανδία δηλώνει η πρωθυπουργός
entry.summary: Denmark pledged to defend Greenland after Trump's renewed insistence that the US should control it, which disrupted the NATO summit. PM Frederiksen called for the Greenlandic people's right to self-determination to be respected.

entry.title: Σε τεντωμένο σχοινί ο ΣΥΡΙΖΑ
entry.summary: Pavlos Polakis is escalating the internal fight in SYRIZA, demanding the reversal of the self-dissolution decision, the resignation of Socratis Famellos and putting himself forward for the leadership at Saturday's Central Committee meeting.

entry.title: Τουρισμός: Μεγάλη μείωση αεροπορικών κρατήσεων
entry.summary: Despite a 7% rise in scheduled airline seats for July-August, bookings show a significant decline for the rest of the season, according to INSETE, notably from the United Kingdom.

entry.title: Ψήφος εμπιστοσύνης στη SpaceX από έξι χρηματιστηριακές
entry.summary: Elon Musk's SpaceX has joined the Nasdaq 100 and drawn buy ratings from at least six brokerages, including Morgan Stanley and Goldman Sachs, after its 86-billion-dollar IPO. It is now viewed also as a player in artificial intelligence.

entry.title: Τα δικά της μαθήματα στο Ιόνιο Πανεπιστήμιο αποκτά η AI
entry.summary: The Ionian University is adding AI instruction to all its undergraduate programmes, aiming for every graduate to gain basic knowledge as well as a critical and ethical stance toward AI.

entry.title: Δύσκολη και κρίσιμη σύνοδος του ΝΑΤΟ
entry.summary: Nikos Konstandaras argues that Greece, accustomed to managing complex situations with an unpredictable and aggressive neighbour-ally, is not out of its depth at the difficult NATO summit in Ankara.

entry.title: Ακίνητα: Παρατείνεται ξανά η αναστολή του ΦΠΑ 24% στα νεόδμητα
entry.summary: The government plans a further one- or two-year extension of the suspension of the 24% VAT on new-build properties and the 15% capital-gains tax on property transfers, with decisions to be finalised ahead of the Thessaloniki trade fair.

entry.title: EPPO: Εφεση κατά της αθώωσης μίας εκ των 58 Κρητικών – Ερευνα για ποινικές ευθύνες υπαλλήλων ΟΠΕΚΕΠΕ
entry.summary: The European Public Prosecutor's Office has appealed the acquittal of one of the 58 Cretan producers over false pasture declarations and is investigating criminal liability of OPEKEPE staff, arguing that repaying the money does not erase the harm.
